failures.rule: The options differ in something besides the decision.
failures.place: Three-item screen on the left, all three listing cards, compared with opt-B.png.
failures.issue: A changes the card composition as well as spacing: photos become large squares instead of shallow landscape crops, and each platform icon sits on its own line above the title instead of beside it. These changes materially affect photo prominence and card height, so the board does not isolate adaptive spacing.

across_options.issue: The options are visibly distinct, but the three-item comparison also changes photo aspect ratio and logo/title arrangement. Keep those properties consistent across A and B to isolate R8 spacing.
